Name: Fourteen Heart Events for All - No Marriage Required
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]This mod makes it possible to see every vanilla marriage candidate's 14 heart event without marrying them, for players who don't want to marry anyone, who are dastardly monogamists and don't fancy Free Love, or who are simply feeling a bit of FOMO. It also makes slight tweaks and edits to the dialogue and event locations to account for the character being good friends with the player instead of being their spouse and patches Sebastian's room after his event to correctly display his terrarium.

In addition to this, [size=3]all tweaked events have had conversation topics added along with over 150 new lines of dialogue related to the 14 heart events that doesn't overwrite or clash with other dialogue mods! [/size]Every vanilla character has dialogue about at least three events depending on who they know and how public the event is.

Optional more significant changes have been made to Shane and Alex's 14 heart events, with Alex's previous 14 heart event being adapted to fit Shane instead and Alex being given an entirely new heart event instead! [/size]

[size=5][b][size=4][size=5]Configuration[/size]
[/size][/b][/size][size=3]
Each character's changes can be toggled individually so that players can choose to experience their spouse's events as vanilla, as well as to provide compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships.[/url] Players can also configure whether the edited 14 heart events will be triggered at 8 hearts or 10 hearts after having seen the appropriate heart event.[b]

[/b]For ease of configuration, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu.
[/url]
[b]

[*][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]EnableLeah[/size][/b]: [size=3]Enables or disables changes to Leah's 14 heart event[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][b][size=3]EnableLeah[/size][/b]: [size=3]Enables or disables changes to Leah's 14 heart event[/size][/size]

The "NoSportsRoom" option will use Alex's alt event and Shane's vanilla event, meant for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14225]Sports Room Event Overhaul.[/url][/size]
[size=3]﻿
[/size][*][size=3][b]FriendshipRequired[/b]: Toggles whether it is required to see the characters' 8 heart events or 10 heart events first. If EnableKrobus is set to 'true', his event will not be affected by this config.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]This mod is specifically compatible with and recommended to be used alongside [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url], which amongst other things edits the 10 heart events to be platonic and this mod's FriendshipRequired 10 hearts setting is designed to be used alongside PPAF. [/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668]Platonic Relationships[/url] is also recommended if you'd like to see the 14 events without gifting bouquets to people.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]RSV, ES, and other expansion mods or map-editing mods may not reflect events 100% correctly but should likely work. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip Mode [/url]is recommended in case of errors with events in modded spaces.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]All events are also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod [/url][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Elliott's event are automatically compatible with ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10243]Realistic Writer Elliott[/url][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Sebastian's terrarium edits are compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7837]Lively Frog Sanctuary[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11080]Secret Garden Frog Terrarium[/url] and [size=3][size=3][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]This mod also pairs well with Asterisk's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12956]Buy 14 Heart Event Furniture and Clothing[/url][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Compatible with [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/487802-immersive-characters-shane]Immersive Characters - Shane[/url]﻿[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14225]Sports Room Event Overhaul[/url] - select "NoSportsRoom" in [size=3][b]EnableShaneAlexAltOrVanilla[/b][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Compatible[b] [/b]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059?]Diverse Stardew Valley[b][/b][/url]﻿[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37277]Frog Tank Interactions[/url]﻿ - one week after seeing Sebastian's altered event, the tank will become interactable via Camiska's mod.[/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][b]﻿
[/b][/size][/size][/size][/list]
[b]Note: Stardew Valley Expanded may or may not cause this mod to have errors.[/b] I haven't checked if the edited events work with SVE's changed maps or if SVE has made changes of its own. I will not make them compatible. Comments asking for SVE compat or reporting SVE clashes as bugs will be deleted.

This mod should theoretically work with Android! It's untested, but the code format is correct. If any Android players would like to try it out and report back, that would be much appreciated.
